id: 08_Test Your Accident Investigation Knowledge Accident Investigation Safety Quiz MC
title: 事故调查十问：查事实，改系统（国内版）

author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/08_Test Your Accident Investigation Knowledge Accident Investigation Safety Quiz MC（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 报告失效：没提系统改进
points.S2: 高校实验室事故报告程序
points.S5: 工效类伤害也要报告调查

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜和空白记录本，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass and a blank notebook and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天当一回事故调查员！
overlay: 事故调查十问：查事实，改系统

shots.scene: 阿杰连续移液好几个小时后，揉着发疼的手腕
shots.prompt_en: After hours of pipetting, the young male student rubs his aching wrist at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰连续移液几小时，手腕疼得厉害。

shots.scene: 阿杰手一抖，试剂瓶在台面上打翻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's hand trembles and a small reagent bottle tips over on the bench, spilling liquid on the tray.
shots.narration: 手一抖，又把一瓶试剂打翻了。

shots.scene: 老周走来，阿杰低头准备挨批
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over while the young male student lowers his head, expecting to be scolded.
shots.narration: 阿杰以为要挨批，老周却说：先查原因。

shots.scene: 十张空白题卡和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank quiz cards with a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题，学会怎么调查。

shots.scene: 天平上一边是事实图标，一边是指责的手指图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a fact sheet icon on one side and a blaming finger icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：事故调查为了什么？

shots.scene: 事实图标一侧落下，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The fact sheet side goes down with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 为了查清事实，不是为了找人问责。

shots.scene: 法槌和逃避检查图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gavel icon and an icon of hiding from an inspector, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 也不是为了定法律责任、躲避检查。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰面对面坐着谈话，桌上空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student sit facing each other calmly with a blank notebook on the table.
shots.narration: 第二题：调查访谈为了什么？

shots.scene: 时间线图标：几个小时的移液、手腕疼、打翻
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with icons: a pipette with a clock, a wrist with a pain mark, and a tipped bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 准确还原发生了什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰放松地讲述，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student relaxes and explains while the older man nods and listens.
shots.narration: 不追责，大家才敢说实话。

shots.section_title: 报告失效：没提系统改进
shots.scene: 一份空白报告被放进抽屉积灰
shots.prompt_en: A blank report placed into a drawer and covered in dust. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：事故报告为啥常常没用？
overlay: 报告失效：没提系统改进

shots.section_title: 报告失效：没提系统改进
shots.scene: 报告上只有“下次小心”的感叹号，没有改进箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank report with only a small exclamation mark and no improvement arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 只写下次注意，不提系统改进。

shots.section_title: 报告失效：没提系统改进
shots.scene: 报告上画出改进箭头和工具、流程图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank report with an improvement arrow pointing to icons of tools and a process chart. No people.
shots.narration: 要改设备、改流程，才不会再发生。

shots.scene: 三个图标：受限的手臂、日历被划掉、黑色花圈
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an arm in a sling, a calendar with crossed-out days and a black ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：哪些伤病必须记录？

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 活动受限、误工、死亡，都要记录。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白登记表，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank incident register with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 国内按事故报告规定和本校制度登记。

shots.scene: 两个箭头：短箭头和长箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows: a short arrow and a long arrow, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：好的建议包括哪两类？

shots.scene: 短期：清理洒漏、阿杰休息手腕
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student cleans the spill tray while the young male student rests his wrist.
shots.narration: 短期：马上清理，阿杰先休息。

shots.scene: 长期：换电动移液器、排班轮换
shots.prompt_en: A new electronic pipette on the bench and a blank rotation schedule on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 长期：换省力的移液器，轮换排班。

shots.scene: 相机、眼睛、空白陈述纸、警戒带四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a camera, an eye, a blank written statement and warning tape. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：哪项不属于现场记录？

shots.scene: 相机、眼睛、陈述纸打勾
shots.prompt_en: The camera, eye and statement icons get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 拍照录像、亲自观察、写初步陈述，都是记录。

shots.scene: 警戒带单独拿出来，标为保护现场
shots.prompt_en: The warning tape icon is moved aside with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拉警戒带是保护现场，不算记录。

shots.scene: 小研在打翻处拍照，旁边放着警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes photos of the spill area next to a caution sign.
shots.narration: 除了抢救需要，先别急着清理现场。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶标签和移液器放在一起拍
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the reagent bottle with a blank label and the pipette placed together for a photo. No people.
shots.narration: 拍下位置、标签、使用的器材。

shots.scene: 清理时戴手套，废物装进专用容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves cleans the spill and places waste into a labeled waste container.
shots.narration: 记录完，再按规定清理和处置。

shots.scene: 现场还有洒漏液体，一个人冲进去的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing into a spill area with fumes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：什么时候开始调查？

shots.scene: 危险解除后，老周戴好防护进入
shots.prompt_en: After the hazard is controlled, the older man wearing goggles and gloves enters to investigate.
shots.narration: 危险排除、确认安全，再开始。

shots.scene: 秒表和规定时限图标被放在一边
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon set aside with a small question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不是抢时间，也不是等别人要求。

shots.scene: 一个大方块被拆成几个小块
shots.prompt_en: A large block is separated into several smaller blocks with gaps between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么叫分析？

shots.scene: 小块分别是人、设备、方法、环境图标
shots.prompt_en: The small blocks show icons of a person, a device, a method sheet and a room. No people.
shots.narration: 把整件事拆成几部分，一块块研究。

shots.scene: 四个选项图标：危险状态、管理体系、不安全行为、常识
shots.prompt_en: Four option icons: a hazard triangle, a management system chart, a person doing something risky and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：多数事故，该先往哪儿想？

shots.scene: 不安全行为图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The risky behavior icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案是不安全行为。

shots.scene: 行为图标后面拉出一条线，连到培训、排班、设备图标
shots.prompt_en: A line from the behavior icon leads back to icons of training, a schedule and equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 可行为背后，常有培训、排班、设备问题。

shots.scene: 阿杰手抖的背后：连续几小时、手动移液器
shots.prompt_en: Behind the young male student's trembling hand appear icons of a long clock and a manual pipette.
shots.narration: 阿杰手抖，是因为连干几小时没休息。

shots.scene: 一棵树，地面上是叶子，地下是根
shots.prompt_en: A tree with leaves above ground and roots below ground. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：找系统缺陷，是哪一步？

shots.scene: 叶子标为表面原因，根部亮起
shots.prompt_en: The leaves fade as surface causes while the roots light up. No people.
shots.narration: 根本原因分析，挖到根上。

shots.scene: 连问几个为什么的气泡，一层层往下
shots.prompt_en: A chain of question mark bubbles going down level by level to the roots. No people.
shots.narration: 多问几个为什么，直到找到系统问题。

shots.section_title: 工效类伤害也要报告调查
shots.scene: 阿杰的手腕疼图标，旁边空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: A wrist pain icon next to a blank incident register. No people.
shots.narration: 手腕劳损、腰背痛，也要报告。
overlay: 工效类伤害也要报告调查

shots.section_title: 工效类伤害也要报告调查
shots.scene: 王老师查看阿杰的工位：台面太高、椅子没调
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator examines the young male student's workstation: the bench is too high and the chair is not adjusted.
shots.narration: 调查工位、动作和工作时长。

shots.section_title: 工效类伤害也要报告调查
shots.scene: 调好椅子高度，换电动移液器，定时休息图标
shots.prompt_en: The chair is adjusted, an electronic pipette is on the bench and a break timer icon floats nearby.
shots.narration: 调工位、换工具、定时休息。

shots.section_title: 工效类伤害也要报告调查
shots.scene: 接触职业病危害人员体检的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a medical checkup with a stethoscope. No people.
shots.narration: 症状持续，要及时就医。

shots.section_title: 高校实验室事故报告程序
shots.scene: 流程箭头：救人、报告负责人、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A flow of arrows with icons: a first aid cross, a lab head, a faculty building and a security badge. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室出事，先救人，再逐级报告。
overlay: 高校实验室事故报告程序

shots.section_title: 高校实验室事故报告程序
shots.scene: 小研拨打电话，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call outside the lab.
shots.narration: 需要时拨打120或119。

shots.section_title: 高校实验室事故报告程序
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白制度文件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank rule document with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 报告时限和程序，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起四块空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four blank boards one after another.
shots.narration: 国内处理事故讲究四不放过。

shots.scene: 四个图标：放大镜、人形、扳手、书本
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a magnifying glass, a person, a wrench and a book. No people.
shots.narration: 原因没查清、责任没处理、

shots.scene: 扳手和书本亮起
shots.prompt_en: The wrench and book icons light up. No people.
shots.narration: 整改没落实、大家没受教育，都不放过。

shots.scene: 阿杰差点碰倒烧瓶，及时扶住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nearly knocks over a flask and catches it just in time.
shots.narration: 差点出事的未遂事件，也要报告。

shots.scene: 组会上老周把这次教训讲给大家
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting, the older man shares the lesson with students around a table.
shots.narration: 把教训讲给大家，别人就不再犯。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with investigation icons.
shots.narration: 十题答完，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 图标：事实、访谈、现场照片
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a fact sheet, two people talking and a camera. No people.
shots.narration: 查事实不问罪，安全了再查，先记录现场。

shots.scene: 图标：树根、短箭头长箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons: tree roots and a short arrow with a long arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 挖根本原因，短期纠正加长期改进。

shots.scene: 阿杰用电动移液器工作，手腕放松，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works with an electronic pipette, wrist relaxed, and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：改了工位，手腕不疼了。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上记录本，挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the notebook and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 查清原因，改好系统，下次见！
